title: DynaGen: Unifying Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning with Dynamic Subgraphs and Generative Regularization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extrapolation reasoning tasks across benchmark datasets (e.g., GDELT, ICEWS, YAGO, WIKI) to test the model's ability to predict unseen future events and emergent patterns, rather than merely imitating the empirical distributions observed in historical training data.
